question.prompt: The side lengths of \(\triangle ABC\) are \(6\), \(8\), and \(10\). Points \(D\), \(E\), and \(F\) are the midpoints of the three sides, respectively. Find the perimeter of \(\triangle DEF\).

solutions.explanation: The three sides of \(\triangle DEF\) are the three midsegments of \(\triangle ABC\), each equal to half the corresponding side. The perimeter is \((6+8+10)\div2=12\).
solutions.title: Perimeter of the midpoint triangle
